title: Control plane service type information element

fields.name: Control plane service type IEI
fields.description: Information Element Identifier for Control plane service type

fields.name: Control plane service type value
fields.description: Control plane service type value: 000=mobile originating request, 001=mobile terminating request, 010=unused (interpreted as mobile originating request)

notes: The Control plane service type is a type 1 information element
Bit 1-3 values: 000 - mobile originating request, 001 - mobile terminating request, 010 - unused; shall be interpreted as 'mobile originating request' if received
